_style.scene: wide 3:2 landscape, a detailed isometric 2D game background in the style of an early-2000s Korean PC business tycoon game: crisp pre-rendered pixel-art look, strict 2:1 isometric projection, saturated warm colours, small dark outlines, many tiny props.
_style.sheet: square 1:1 image that is a character sheet of four separate portraits arranged as a strict 2x2 grid of four exactly equal square quadrants, with no gaps, no borders and no frames between them; each quadrant is completely filled by its own flat soft pastel background colour with a subtle lighter circle behind the head. Each quadrant holds one bust shot (head and shoulders, centred, whole head inside the quadrant with some margin) of a different original character for a game dialog window, all drawn in the same polished Korean webtoon / anime illustration style with clean line art and soft cel shading, facing slightly to the side and looking at the viewer.

_tail.scene: No user interface, no windows or popups, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.
_tail.sheet: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no hands near the face.

scene-home: The image is filled edge to edge by the cutaway interior of a small cheap one-room student studio apartment seen from above with the front walls removed. A single bed with a rumpled blanket, a cluttered study desk with a laptop and a small toy-grade quadcopter drone and a radio controller, textbooks stacked on the floor, a tiny kitchenette with a rice cooker and instant noodle cups, a clothes rack, a mini fridge, a floor fan, a low table with a snack, a window with curtains, a shoe rack by the door, posters of drones and aircraft with simple shapes only, a small balcony with a laundry rack. One tiny chibi-proportioned young student in a hoodie sitting at the desk studying, in the same pixel style.
scene-school: The image is filled edge to edge by the cutaway interior of a university drone department building seen from above with the front walls removed. Rooms: a lecture classroom with rows of desks, a lectern and a green chalkboard with simple drone diagrams (no letters); a flight simulator lab with a row of computers, monitors and radio controllers on desks; a hallway with lockers, a vending machine, a notice board with blank papers and potted plants; a small display shelf with model drones. Seven or eight tiny chibi-proportioned people in the same pixel style: a professor at the chalkboard, students sitting at desks, two students at the simulators, one walking in the hallway with a backpack.
scene-airfield: The image is filled edge to edge by an outdoor drone flight training field seen from above: a neatly mown green grass field with white painted landing circles and square landing pads, rows of orange traffic cones marking a flight course, a red-and-white windsock on a pole, a small open-sided tent with a folding table, drone cases and battery chargers, a white safety fence with netting, benches, a small storage container shed, trees along the edge. Four small quadcopter drones hovering low over the pads. Six or seven tiny chibi-proportioned people in the same pixel style: trainees in safety vests holding radio controllers, an instructor with a clipboard, an examiner seated at the table under the tent.
scene-town: The image is filled edge to edge by a lively Korean downtown shopping street corner seen from above: small multi-storey shop buildings with colourful awnings and blank signboards (no letters), a convenience store, a cafe with outdoor tables and parasols, a chicken restaurant, a street food cart, a crosswalk, street trees, street lamps, a bus stop shelter, parked scooters and a delivery van, a small plaza with a fountain and a small event stage with balloons. Eight or nine tiny chibi-proportioned people in the same pixel style walking, sitting at the cafe, one handing out flyers, one young person flying a small drone over the plaza.
scene-shop: The image is filled edge to edge by the cutaway interior of a drone and camera equipment shop seen from above with the front walls removed. Glass display counters with quadcopter drones of several sizes, wall shelves full of drone boxes, propellers, batteries and radio controllers, a row of FPV goggles on stands, a big agricultural spraying drone on a display podium, camera gimbals and lenses in a glass case, a cash register counter, a small test-flight cage with netting in the corner, a storeroom with stacked cardboard boxes, a glass shop front, and outside it a white utility van parked on the pavement. Five or six tiny chibi-proportioned people in the same pixel style: a shop clerk in an apron behind the counter, customers looking at drones, one carrying a box.
scene-garage: The image is filled edge to edge by the cutaway interior of a drone repair workshop and hangar seen from above with the front walls removed. Concrete floor with yellow safety lines, long workbenches with disassembled quadcopter drones, soldering stations, magnifier lamps and tool chests, pegboard walls with hanging tools, shelves of spare motors, propellers and batteries, a red rolling tool cabinet, a large industrial hexacopter on a maintenance stand, a battery charging rack, a parts washing sink, an open roll-up hangar door, oil drums, a fire extinguisher, a small office corner with a desk and a computer. Five or six tiny chibi-proportioned mechanics in blue overalls in the same pixel style: repairing drones at the benches, one carrying a propeller, one testing a drone hovering inside a net cage.
scene-bank: The image is filled edge to edge by the cutaway interior of a bank branch seen from above with the front walls removed. A long teller counter with glass partitions and computers, a waiting area with rows of blue seats and a ticket machine, a marble floor with a patterned carpet, a loan consultation desk with two chairs, a row of cash machines, a big round steel vault door standing ajar with stacks of banknotes and gold coins visible inside, a security desk, potted palms, a brochure stand with blank papers, a manager office with a wooden desk behind low glass partition walls. Seven or eight tiny chibi-proportioned people in the same pixel style: tellers in uniforms behind the counter, customers waiting on the seats, one customer at the loan desk talking to a banker in a suit, a security guard.
scene-farm: The image is filled edge to edge by a countryside farm seen from above: green rice paddies in neat rectangular plots separated by narrow dirt paths and irrigation channels, a vegetable field with rows of crops, plastic greenhouses, a small farmhouse with a tiled roof, a red tractor, a white pickup truck with drone cases and chemical tanks in the back, a scarecrow, a water pump, haystacks, a few trees. Four or five tiny chibi-proportioned people in the same pixel style: a drone pilot with a radio controller standing on the path, a helper next to the truck, farmers in straw hats watching.
scene-site: The image is filled edge to edge by a construction site seen from above: a half-built concrete building with steel rebar and scaffolding, a yellow tower crane, an excavator and a dump truck on brown dirt, stacks of steel beams and pipes, cement mixer, site office containers, orange safety fences and cones, a surveying tripod, piles of sand and gravel. Six or seven tiny chibi-proportioned people in the same pixel style: workers in yellow hard hats and safety vests, a drone pilot with a radio controller and a tablet, a site manager pointing at plans on a folding table (plans show simple lines only).
scene-bridge: The image is filled edge to edge by a large cable-stayed road bridge crossing a wide blue river, seen from above at an angle so the tall concrete pylon, the fan of cables and the underside girders are visible; cars and a bus on the bridge deck, a grassy riverside park with a walking path and benches in the foreground, an inspection work boat on the water, a white utility van parked on the bank with open rear doors showing drone cases, orange cones around it. Four or five tiny chibi-proportioned people in the same pixel style: a drone pilot with a radio controller and a monitor on a tripod, an engineer in a hard hat with a tablet, a helper, a person walking a dog in the park.
scene-windfarm: The image is filled edge to edge by a hilltop wind farm seen from above: five tall white three-blade wind turbines standing on green grassy ridges with a winding gravel service road, a small substation building with transformers and a fence, a white utility van and a pickup truck parked near the base of the nearest turbine, drone cases and a folding table with a monitor, low clouds and a glimpse of the sea beyond the hills. Two inspection quadcopter drones flying very close to a turbine blade. Four or five tiny chibi-proportioned people in the same pixel style at the base of the nearest turbine: a drone pilot with a radio controller, a technician in a hard hat with a tablet, two helpers in safety vests.
scene-studio: The image is filled edge to edge by an outdoor film and television shooting set seen from above: a backlot street with a fake traditional Korean tiled-roof house facade and a fake modern cafe facade held up by wooden supports, a camera crane, a camera dolly on rails, big lighting stands and reflector boards, a director's chairs area under a parasol with monitors, cables on the ground, equipment trucks, a make-up tent, a catering table, prop boxes. Eight or nine tiny chibi-proportioned people in the same pixel style: a director with a megaphone, camera operators, two actors in costume, a drone pilot with a radio controller and a camera operator beside them with a monitor, crew carrying equipment.
scene-coast: The image is filled edge to edge by a rocky sea coast seen from above: a sandy beach curving into dark rocks and a small cliff with a white lighthouse, turquoise sea with white waves, a small harbour pier with fishing boats, a red-and-white rescue boat on the water, a rescue station hut with a watch tower, an orange rescue truck and a white van parked on the shore road, drone cases and a command table with monitors under a tent, life rings and ropes. scene-solo: The image is filled edge to edge by the cutaway interior of a tiny one-person drone business office in a small rented room seen from above with the front walls removed: one wooden desk with a computer and two monitors showing aerial photos, an office chair, a single workbench with one quadcopter drone under repair and a soldering iron, a metal shelf with a few drone cases and batteries, a wall calendar and a corkboard with blank notes, a small sofa bed with a blanket, a coffee machine on a mini fridge, a filing cabinet, a potted plant, stacked delivery boxes, a floor lamp; outside the open door a small parking spot with one white utility van. scene-hq: The image is filled edge to edge by the cutaway interior of a large, busy headquarters floor of a successful drone company seen from above with the front walls removed and low glass partition walls between rooms. Rooms: a big open-plan work area with four long rows of desks with computers and many office chairs; a glass-walled executive office with a large wooden desk, leather chair and a trophy shelf; a large drone engineering lab with several workbenches, many quadcopter and hexacopter drones, a test-flight net cage and a robot arm; a flight operations control room with a wall of monitors showing maps and aerial views; a big conference room with a long table and many chairs; a lounge and cafe bar with sofas and plants on checkered tiles; a reception desk with a display of drones on pedestals; server racks; a long charging wall with rows of drone batteries. Eighteen to twenty tiny chibi-proportioned employees in the same pixel style working at desks, repairing drones, in a meeting, at the control room, carrying boxes, chatting in the lounge.
scene-academy: The image is filled edge to edge by a drone pilot training academy seen from above, half cutaway building with the front walls removed and half outdoor yard. Indoor rooms: a classroom with rows of desks and a whiteboard with simple drone diagrams (no letters), a simulator room with a row of computer stations and radio controllers, a front desk with trophies and framed certificates with blank faces, an equipment room with shelves of training drones and batteries. Outdoor yard: an artificial turf practice field with white landing circles, orange cones, a safety net fence, a windsock, and four training drones hovering in a row. Ten or eleven tiny chibi-proportioned people in the same pixel style: an instructor in a red jacket teaching in the classroom, trainees at desks and at simulators, trainees in safety vests flying drones in the yard with an instructor holding a clipboard, a receptionist.
scene-assoc: The image is filled edge to edge by the cutaway interior of a stately pilots' association hall seen from above with the front walls removed. Rooms: a grand assembly hall with a red carpet, rows of chairs facing a stage with a wooden podium, blank banners and flags with simple emblems of wings; a boardroom with a large oval wooden table and leather chairs; a chairman's office with a heavy wooden desk, bookshelves and a globe; a trophy and history gallery with glass cases holding model aircraft, old drones and medals; a marble lobby with columns, a reception desk and big potted plants. Ten or eleven tiny chibi-proportioned people in formal suits in the same pixel style: a speaker at the podium, members seated in the hall, directors meeting in the boardroom, a secretary at the reception desk, two people shaking hands in the lobby.
